title: US-Iranian Kamran Hekmati Released From Tehran Prison But Can't Leave Country
content: An Iranian-American citizen, Kamran Hekmati, has been released from Tehran's notorious Evin Prison, sources have told RFE/RL's Radio Farda, but he is unable to leave the country due to a travel ban.

title: Emblem-Shattering Monument In Russia Sparks Outcry In Japan

title: 'They Save Us': Ukrainian Volunteers Rescue Pets Under Fire
content: Volunteers from Ukraine's UAnimals charity dodge Russian drones to rescue people's pets in cities under fire in the Donetsk region. They've saved hundreds of animals, from beloved dogs and cats to jittery goats and raccoons, delivering them to new homes in safer areas far from the front lines.

title: 'It Feels Like A Safari': How Zaporizhzhya Survives Daily Russian Attacks

title: Blinded By Iranian Security Forces, A Protester Now Faces The Death Sentence
content: An Iranian man was blinded by security forces during the mass nationwide Women, Life, Freedom protests in 2022. He fled the country but then returned and has now been sentenced to death by hanging.

title: Partially Blinded Protester Sentenced To Death After Returning To Iran
content: An Iranian court has sentenced a partially blinded protester to death after he returned to Iran. Ali Zarei was blinded in one eye when he was shot by security forces during the 2022 Women, Life, Freedom protests.
